cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set (G1): tuition $48,179, required fees $900, food and housing $20,766 (housing $12,477 + meals $8,289). Estimated expenses: books $1,104, transportation $1,290, other $4,794 (other costs shown = transportation + other). The CDS prints no total cost of attendance and no separate international tuition. Aid to nonresidents (H6): the CDS ticks only institutional non-need-based scholarship and grant aid, and 509 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid averaging $23,186 (the aid count and average are not split by need or merit).

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class). C1 prints men and women rows only (applied 10,722 men + 16,740 women; admitted 9,415 + 14,696; enrolled 1,171 + 1,627), so the totals shown are those sums and the CDS 'total' cells are blank; the first-year enrollment total also matches B2 (2,798). That is a much larger share admitted than College Navigator shows for fall 2024 (31,266 applicants, 76% admitted); the CDS does not say why. The residency breakdown (in-state, out-of-state, international) is left blank in the CDS, so those counts are not shown (B2 lists 130 nonresident first-time first-year students enrolled). No early decision; early action is non-binding and its counts are not reported. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (the below-1.0 band is 0.0% and is left out); 94% of first-years reported a GPA. SAT/ACT are optional: 30% of first-years submitted the SAT (850 students) and 11% the ACT (298). Undergraduate enrollment (14,338) and the nonresident count (615) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B2.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set: SAT and ACT are 'considered' if submitted; DePaul 'has adopted a test-optional alternative for freshman admission'.
